name: ironalarm-effect-refactor
north_star: Proper Effect-TS library with dependency injection, testable APIs, and composable patterns
goal: Transform ironalarm from Promise-wrapped Effect to proper Effect-TS patterns: Context/Service, Schedule for retry, Fiber concurrency, structured logging

blocking_issues: Test handlers partially updated - vitest-pool-workers serialization errors
Mixed async patterns still present in example worker (setTimeout in triggerBroadcast)

error_design.principle: All failures are explicit in the error channel. No swallowed exceptions.

errors.message: No handler registered for task name
errors.when: schedule() or runNow() called with unregistered taskName
errors.user_action: Register handler via scheduler.register(name, handler) before scheduling

errors.message: Task operation conflicts with current state
errors.when: Pausing running task, resuming non-paused task, etc.

security_audit.overall_risk: LOW for library, MEDIUM for example

findings.issue: taskId and taskName are not validated for malicious characters
findings.risk: Potential storage key injection if malicious taskId like '../../../etc' is passed
findings.recommendation: Add taskId/taskName validation: alphanumeric + hyphen/underscore only, max 128 chars

findings.issue: Checkpoint keys are not validated, allowing arbitrary keys in progress object
findings.risk: Could overwrite internal keys like 'completed', 'error' from handlers
findings.recommendation: Consider reserving keys starting with '_' for internal use

findings.issue: No limit on total number of tasks that can be created
findings.risk: Malicious actor could create millions of tasks, exhausting DO storage
findings.recommendation: Add maxTotalTasks option with reasonable default (e.g., 10000)

findings.issue: Exposes all progress data including potentially sensitive checkpoint values
findings.risk: Internal state could leak to clients
findings.recommendation: Allow configurable field filtering in formatTaskForUI

findings.issue: Broadcasting to all clients on every mutation without throttling
findings.risk: With many clients and frequent updates, could overwhelm network/clients
findings.recommendation: Already has triggerBroadcast debounce at 100ms - verify it's used everywhere

findings.issue: Cache invalidation before transaction completion could cause stale reads
findings.risk: Inconsistent task state between concurrent operations
findings.recommendation: Move invalidateCache() calls to after transaction commits

findings.issue: Still using console.log/console.error instead of Effect.log
findings.risk: Inconsistent logging, harder to trace issues
findings.recommendation: Migrate all console.* to Effect.log* for consistency

findings.risk: DO stays awake unnecessarily, consuming CPU quota

no_issues_found: No SQL injection possible (using DO storage, not SQL)
No XSS vectors in library (no HTML rendering)
No unsafe deserialization of user input
Proper use of DO transactions for atomicity

single_do_bottleneck.issue: Example uses only 3 shards via getShardId(), all tasks for same key go to same DO
single_do_bottleneck.impact: Will break at ~100-500 concurrent users per shard
single_do_bottleneck.recommendation: Implement per-user or per-namespace DO sharding for production

broadcast_storm.issue: Broadcasts ALL tasks to ALL clients on every mutation
broadcast_storm.impact: N*M network traffic where N=clients, M=tasks
broadcast_storm.recommendation: Send only deltas, implement subscription filtering by namespace

effect_ts_complexity.issue: Effect.runPromise inside Effect.gen creates nested Effect execution
effect_ts_complexity.impact: Harder to reason about, potential for missed error handling
effect_ts_complexity.recommendation: Consider pure Effect composition without intermediate runPromise calls

stories.title: Fix vitest-pool-workers Effect serialization errors
stories.description: Test suite fails with 'Could not serialize object of type EffectPrimitive' and isolated storage errors
acceptance_criteria: All tests pass without serialization errors
No 'isolated storage stack frame' errors
Tests properly await all Effect operations
Test handlers correctly yield* SchedulerService from context
DO methods in test-worker.ts wrap Effect.runPromise before returning

root_cause_analysis.error_message: DataCloneError: Could not serialize object of type 'EffectPrimitive'
root_cause_analysis.likely_cause: test-worker.ts DO methods return Effect<T> but vitest-pool-workers tries to serialize across RPC boundary. Effect objects are not serializable.
root_cause_analysis.fix_approach: Wrap all DO method returns in Effect.runPromise so they return Promise<T> not Effect<T>

stories.test_coverage: This story IS the test fix. Verification is all tests passing.
stories.verification: bun run test passes with 0 errors, all 102+ tests pass

rules.error_handling: All failures must be in the error channel (E in Effect<A, E, R>). No try/catch that swallows errors.
rules.tests_first: Write tests BEFORE implementing. All tests must pass before moving to next story.
rules.git_checkpoints: Commit after each story with message: 'feat: [ID] - [Title]'
rules.verification: Every story requires: typecheck passes AND bun test passes
rules.test_requirement: Every story MUST have either a test_file or test_justification explaining why automated testing is not feasible
rules.security: Review SEC-* findings before each release
rules.no_settimeout: NEVER use setTimeout in Durable Objects - use alarm-based scheduling for hibernation support
